name: buddy-server
description: P5 AI Coding Buddy — gateway + in-house model engine. Networked; outside game lint scope.

scripts.//start: Loads server/.env if present. --env-file-if-exists (NOT --env-file, which EXITS when the file is absent) keeps the zero-config path working: no .env, no keys, buddy still runs on the free default. Without this flag Node ignores .env entirely and every key a teacher writes there is silently invisible.
